assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production real-time racing game architecture material texture atlas. One square image, exactly 2 columns by 2 rows of equal square material tiles, no gutters, no margins. All texture views perfectly orthographic front-facing, surface fills every tile edge-to-edge. This will be UV mapped on actual 3D buildings, not shown as concept art.
Primary request: extremely refined photorealistic architectural surfaces for NIGHTSHIFT, a cinematic dusk street racing game with restrained Nervos cellular architecture. Top left: premium midnight blue glass office tower curtain wall, a precise repeating grid of narrow brushed-metal mullions, 8 columns and 10 rows of recessed windows. About 25 percent of windows reveal warm amber interior floors, blinds and fine ceiling lights; remaining panes dark navy reflecting a subdued sky. Top right: elegant graphite and pale stone research data-center facade with recessed rectangular cellular glass bays, fine aluminum edges, subtle mint interior lights, machined rain streaks, credible engineering. Bottom left: coastal harbor warehouse frontage, oxidized teal corrugated steel, dark tall industrial windows with warm interior light, concrete pilasters, fine rust and rivets, no doors or typography. Bottom right: modern low-rise stone and bronze commercial facade, repeating broad rectangular windows, warm softly lit interiors, precise narrow dark frames, textured pale gray limestone between windows. All four material cells keep realistic human-scale construction details, restrained contrast, readable midtones, high detail without noisy clutter. Flat diffuse blue-hour lighting, subtle baked cavity shading only; luminous windows are bright but never bloom or clip white. Similar edges for tileable repetition. No perspective, no roof, no ground, no skyline, no isolated full buildings, no people, no roads, no cars, no text, no lettering, no logos, no symbols, no watermark.
assets.usage: Four facade families, physical scale UVs, lit windows and material variation.
assets.encoding: WebP quality 88; format conversion only; generated alpha preserved where present.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game-ready transparent lighting texture atlas for a premium real-time night racing game, square canvas divided into exactly four equal square cells, 2 columns by 2 rows. Real alpha transparency, no visible checkerboard or background color.
Primary request: four useful physically plausible street-light component textures. Top left cell: close-up perfectly orthographic straight-on view of one modern rectangular LED street-lamp diffuser panel, isolated. A long horizontal rounded rectangle centered in its square cell, width 80% cell, height 32% cell. Refined brushed aluminum rim, protective clear prismatic ribbed glass, rows of small warm-white LED lenses and realistic fine manufacturing detail. Its full body and edges visible, margin transparent. No pole. Top right cell: a soft circular warm-white and pale amber optical glow for a lamp halo, bright compact white core with a softly fading golden atmospheric corona, no hard rays or large lens flare, every edge fades fully to transparent, centered with wide transparent margin. Bottom left cell: a matching cool-white pale cyan optical glow, same restrained dimensions and falloff, fully transparent at edges. Bottom right cell: a soft feathered oval pool of pale neutral warm-white illumination, viewed directly from overhead, containing delicate broken wet asphalt reflection grain and a slightly elongated diffuse center, width 65% cell and height 85% cell, edges smoothly fade fully into transparency. This last element is a projected lighting overlay, not an opaque asphalt tile; only light and fine scattered reflection are present.
Style: physically believable cinematic lighting elements, controlled bloom, subtle photographic grain. Each item confined entirely to its own square quadrant, generous transparent separation from all cell edges. No grid lines, text, labels, characters, objects outside the lamp panel, UI, symbols, logos, watermark, solid background, or heavy starbursts.
assets.usage: LED diffuser, warm/cool lamp halos and road illumination.
assets.encoding: WebP quality 88; format conversion only; generated alpha preserved where present.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium real-time vehicle combat VFX sprite atlas, wide 2:1 aspect ratio, exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows of EIGHT equal square cells. Actual alpha-transparent background. Each effect entirely inside its own cell with at least 12 percent empty transparent padding on every edge; nothing crosses cell borders. No visible grid.
Primary request: physically convincing cinematic automotive combat effects, delicate layered detail, restrained bright cores, rich intermediate opacity, realistic smoke and fine high-speed sparks, avoiding toy-like magical explosions. Reading order left to right, top then bottom: (0) a directional shower of fine orange-white hot metal sparks and a few tiny dark fragments from a glancing car impact, sweeping rightward, compact impact origin, open airy silhouette; (1) a short grounded mechanical flare, a small turbulent amber fuel flash partly enveloped in charcoal smoke, transparent broken edges, no gigantic round fireball; (2) a subtle curved cyan electromagnetic protection field, a thin incomplete elliptical perimeter with fine cellular hex filaments and a few bright contact arcs, mostly empty transparent center, not a solid glowing ball; (3) a broken protection field with a few delicate cyan cell fragments separating outward, sparse sharp ice-like light shards with transparent gaps, readable collapse; (4) a narrow cyan-white electrical discharge streak traveling horizontally left to right, a fine white core with very sparse branching arcs and tapered ends, transparent around it, not a comet or energy sphere; (5) a low soft expanding road-dust puff, translucent warm-gray wisps mixed with a few fine gritty particles, airy transparent center and irregular natural outline; (6) a thin layered gray tire-smoke curl, physically detailed turbulent wisps with lots of transparent gaps, no opaque cauliflower ball; (7) an elegant thin oval ground shockwave, pearly cyan rim with slight violet diffraction and broken asymmetric electrical filaments, almost entirely transparent center, realistic transient ripple not a sci-fi HUD graphic.
All eight sprites share believable film-VFX lighting and photographic detail. Avoid full white circles, giant saturated clouds, cartoon stars, thick rings, colored rectangles, baked backgrounds, labels, text, logos, borders and watermark. Real clean alpha everywhere outside the actual effect. Original production assets for NIGHTSHIFT.
assets.usage: Impact sparks, fatal flare, protection, shield break, EMP ribbon, dust, smoke and ground shockwave.
assets.encoding: WebP quality 88; format conversion only; generated alpha preserved where present.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: real-time racing game ANIMATED FLIPBOOK sprite sheet, wide 2:1 canvas, FOUR columns and TWO rows, eight equal square frames. Actual alpha transparent background. Each frame centered inside its own square with 12 percent transparent padding. No visible grid.
Primary request: two coherent four-frame animations at film VFX quality. TOP ROW, frames 1 through 4 left to right: the same small wispy gray-white tire smoke puff evolving through time, first tight delicate curling wisp, then slightly expanding softly rolling puff, then wider thinned-out turbulent tendrils, finally dissipating into fine airy filaments. Same source location at bottom center of each frame. Photorealistic translucent smoke with irregular layered density and fully transparent gaps, no explosion, no solid white cotton ball, no opaque gray background. BOTTOM ROW, frames 1 through 4: the same short controlled blue automotive nitrous exhaust plume subtly flickering through four successive moments. Origin at the BOTTOM center of each frame, jet points vertically UP. Short narrow luminous pale-cyan core, soft hot white root, faint deep-blue turbulent outer flame, tapered clean tip. Jet length about 65 percent of the square, maximum width 25 percent, not lightning, not a giant rocket flame. All four flame frames retain the same size and root while small turbulence changes naturally.
Color and rendering: realistic premium automotive visual effects, not magic spells. Smooth alpha edges, modest bloom only at the flame core, no backgrounds, thick outlines, characters, debris, text, captions, labels, logos, watermark or borders. Smoke must remain visibly translucent and fine. The engine will interpolate and animate these original frames in 3D.
assets.usage: Four-frame tire smoke and four-frame nitrous exhaust animation.
assets.encoding: WebP quality 88; format conversion only; generated alpha preserved where present.
